name: Huércal de Almería (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of white, red and green with a broad green fly, charged on the red stripe with the crowned municipal arms of Huércal de Almería (a crescent above a tower on red).
history: Municipal flag of Huércal de Almería; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Huércal de Almería arms — crescent above a tower on red
